reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model SE4570, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The label's date code is 08/23. The recalled date codes are only 07/22 and 08/22, so this date code is outside the recall and the claim fails.

The retailer (www.justinboots.com) is on the sale list and the purchase date of 2023-05-06 is inside the sale window, so the purchase is valid. This does not change the outcome because the date code is out of range.
No other claim shares a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account with this one.
